newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panamanian shipping firm to issue $6 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Panamanian shipping firm to issue $6 mln in bonds.

text.p: A subsidiary of a Panamanian shipping company plans to issue $6 million in bonds through Panama's stock exchange on Oct 10, officials said Thursday.
Gorse Down Ltd will issue the bonds to add two cargo ships to its fleet of six, said Dulcidio de la Guardia, general director of Capital Traders of Panama which will handle the issue.

The bond issue, the first for a Panamanian shipping company on Panama's Bolsa, will help the company pay the purchase of one tanker used to carry petroleum products and one "roll- on/roll-off" ship to transport vehicles, De la Guardia said.
Gorse Down is a subsidiary of International Carriers Corp, the holding company of Panamanian Carriers Corp, one of Panama's most important shipping companies.
The bonds will be issued in denominations of $1,000 at a 10 percent interest rate. They mature March 25, 2000.
